checks: Account creation, teacher approval and invitation resend require administrator permission
New teacher applications require an email address and retain a private review record
Approval retries are idempotent and create one invited teacher account
Approved applications cannot be silently changed through ordinary inquiry status controls
Bearer tokens are hashed in invitation records and encrypted in the mail queue
An invited account cannot sign in or bypass verification through the ordinary activate button
Opening and previewing an invitation never consumes it; the activation page is private from indexing and referrers
Real local SMTP sends a formal branded approval in Arabic with a private single-action verification link
Weak passwords, mismatched confirmation, missing consent and an unrelated signed-in session cannot activate the account
One successful redemption verifies email, activates the teacher and permits normal sign-in without creating an extra session
Successful verification automatically queues one account confirmation without a password in the message
Used or tampered links cannot be replayed, and accepting a teacher invitation grants no administrator privileges
Resending rotates the token and cancels unsent copies of the previous invitation
Administrators can revoke an unused invitation immediately without deleting the account
Invitations bind to the account email; an administrator must issue a fresh link after changing that address
Expired invitations cannot activate accounts and are cancelled before SMTP delivery
Administrators can invite students with the existing profile and consent requirements
An invited student completes verification and can access the student workspace
Existing administrator password-based account creation remains available
Conflicting existing accounts and ordinary contact inquiries are never overwritten or converted into teachers
Concurrent approval requests create exactly one account and invitation
Resending an approved teacher invitation preserves the formal approval message and application association
Concurrent token redemptions permit one successful activation only
Account lists and operational mail logs never return invitation secrets or password hashes
Test workers fail closed when their local receiver is missing and never fall back to an external SMTP relay
